verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerts overview says any signal can be evaluated for abnormal behavior instead of only against a threshold, so the docs claim anomaly-based alerting without hand-set thresholds. That claim rests on a single sentence, with no detail on how baselines or outliers are computed or configured and no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: documentation of anomaly/baseline detection mechanics and configuration, outlier detection across entities, sensitivity tuning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can enable anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds

citations.quote: Configure any signal to be evaluated against a threshold, or if it exhibits abnormal behavior.
